description: issue #673: `new_turtle` (Sprites, R/0->turtle) allocates the first spawned turtle (id 1, one past the reserved main turtle id 0) and emits exactly one `spawn-turtle` trace event immediately after the turtle exists, carrying its id in both the envelope `turtle_id` and the payload plus the full initial visible state from spec/turtles-and-sprites.md's Turtle creation section (origin at canvas center [0,0], heading 0 up, pen down, color black, width 1, visible, default `turtle` shape).
